bodyChildren.title: difficulty
bodyChildren.desc: Normal is the classic typing test experience. Expert fails the test if you submit (press space) an incorrect word. Master fails if you press a single incorrect key (meaning you have to achieve 100% accuracy).

bodyChildren.title: quick restart
bodyChildren.desc: Press tab, esc or enter to quickly restart the test, or to quickly jump to the test page. These options disable tab navigation on most parts of the website. Using the "esc" option will move opening the commandline to the tab key.

bodyChildren.title: repeat quotes
bodyChildren.desc: This setting changes the restarting behavior when typing in quote mode. Changing it to 'typing' will repeat the quote if you restart while typing.

bodyChildren.title: blind mode
bodyChildren.desc: No errors or incorrect words are highlighted. Helps you to focus on raw speed. If enabled, quick end is recommended.

bodyChildren.title: always show words history
bodyChildren.desc: This option will automatically show the words history at the end of the test. Can cause slight lag with a lot of words.

bodyChildren.title: single list command line
bodyChildren.desc: When enabled, it will show the command line with all commands in a single list instead of submenu arrangements. Selecting 'manual' will expose all commands only after typing >.

bodyChildren.title: min speed
bodyChildren.desc: Automatically fails a test if your speed falls below a threshold.

bodyChildren.title: min accuracy
bodyChildren.desc: Automatically fails a test if your accuracy falls below a threshold.

bodyChildren.title: min word burst
bodyChildren.desc: Automatically fails a test if your raw for a single word falls below this threshold. Selecting 'flex' allows for this threshold to automatically decrease for longer words.

bodyChildren.title: british english
bodyChildren.desc: When enabled, the website will use the British spelling instead of American. Note that this might not replace all words correctly. If you find any issues, please let us know.

bodyChildren.title: language
bodyChildren.desc: Change in which language you want to type.english

bodyChildren.title: funbox
bodyChildren.desc: These are special modes that change the website in some special way (by altering the word generation, behavior of the website or the looks). Give each one of them a try!

bodyChildren.title: custom layoutfluid
bodyChildren.desc: Select which layouts you want the layoutfluid funbox to cycle through.qwertydvorakcolemak

bodyChildren.title: polyglot languages
bodyChildren.desc: Select which languages you want the polyglot funbox to use.englishspanishfrenchgerman

bodyChildren.title: freedom mode
bodyChildren.desc: Allows you to delete any word, even if it was typed correctly.

bodyChildren.title: strict space
bodyChildren.desc: Pressing space at the beginning of a word will insert a space character when this mode is enabled.

bodyChildren.title: opposite shift mode
bodyChildren.desc: This mode will force you to use opposite shift keys for shifting. Using an incorrect one will count as an error. This feature ignores keys in locations B, Y, and ^ because many people use the other hand for those keys. If you're using external software to emulate your layout (including QMK), you should use the "keymap" mode - the standard "on" will not work. This will enforce opposite shift based on the "keymap layout" setting.

bodyChildren.title: stop on error
bodyChildren.desc: Letter mode will stop input when pressing any incorrect letters. Word mode will not allow you to continue to the next word until you correct all mistakes.

bodyChildren.title: delete on error
bodyChildren.desc: Letter mode will automatically delete the incorrect character and the one before it. Word mode will delete the entire current word. The hard variants will additionally jump back to the previous word if you make a mistake on the first character.

bodyChildren.title: confidence mode
bodyChildren.desc: When enabled, you will not be able to go back to previous words to fix mistakes. When turned up to the max, you won't be able to backspace at all.

bodyChildren.title: quick end
bodyChildren.desc: This only applies to the words mode - when enabled, the test will end as soon as the last word has been typed, even if it's incorrect. When disabled, you need to manually confirm the last incorrect entry with a space.

bodyChildren.title: indicate typos
bodyChildren.desc: Shows typos that you've made. "Below" shows what you typed below the letters, "replace" will replace the letters with the ones you typed and "both" will do the same as replace and below, but it will show the correct letters below your mistakes.

bodyChildren.title: hide extra letters
bodyChildren.desc: Hides extra letters. This will completely avoid words jumping lines (due to changing width), but might feel a bit confusing when you press a key and nothing happens.

bodyChildren.title: composition display
bodyChildren.desc: Change how composition is displayed. "off" will just underline the letter if composition is active. "below" will show the composed character below the test. "replace" will replace the letter in the test with the composed character.

bodyChildren.title: lazy mode
bodyChildren.desc: Replaces accents / diacritics / special characters with their normal letter equivalents.

bodyChildren.title: layout
bodyChildren.desc: With this setting you can emulate other layouts. This setting is best kept off, as it can break things like dead keys and alt layers.qwerty

bodyChildren.title: code unindent on backspace
bodyChildren.desc: Automatically go back to the previous line when deleting line leading tab characters. Only works in code languages.

bodyChildren.title: sound volume
bodyChildren.desc: Change the volume of the sound effects.0.5

bodyChildren.title: play sound on click
bodyChildren.desc: Plays a short sound when you press a key.

bodyChildren.title: play sound on error
bodyChildren.desc: Plays a short sound if you press an incorrect key or press space too early.

bodyChildren.title: play time warning
bodyChildren.desc: Play a short warning sound if you are close to the end of a timed test.

bodyChildren.title: smooth caret
bodyChildren.desc: The caret will move smoothly between letters and words.

bodyChildren.title: caret style
bodyChildren.desc: Change the style of the caret during the test.

bodyChildren.title: pace caret
bodyChildren.desc: Displays a second caret that moves at constant speed. The 'average' option averages the speed of last 10 results. The 'tag pb' option takes the highest PB of any active tag. The 'daily' option takes the highest speed of the last 24 hours.

bodyChildren.title: repeated pace
bodyChildren.desc: When repeating a test, a pace caret will automatically be enabled for one test with the speed of your previous test. It does not override the pace caret if it's already enabled.

bodyChildren.title: pace caret style
bodyChildren.desc: Change the style of the pace caret during the test.

headerClass: inline-flex h-min cursor-pointer appearance-none items-center justify-center rounded border-0 text-center transition-[color,background,opacity] duration-125 ease-in-out select-none focus-visible:shadow-[0_0_0_0.1rem_var(--bg-color),_0_0_0_0.2rem_var(--text-color)] focus-visible:outline-none bg-(--themable-button-bg) text-(--themable-button-text) hover:bg-(--themable-button-hover-bg) hover:text-(--themable-button-hover-text) [--themable-button-active:var(--main-color)] [--themable-button-bg:transparent] [--themable-button-hover-bg:transparent] [--themable-button-hover-text:var(--text-color)] [--themable-button-text:var(--sub-color)] active:text-sub mb-8 w-max gap-4 p-0 text-4xl

bodyChildren.title: live progress style
bodyChildren.desc: Change the style of the timer/word count during a test. "Flash" styles will briefly show the timer in timed modes every 15 seconds.

bodyChildren.title: live speed style
bodyChildren.desc: Change the style of the live speed displayed during the test.

bodyChildren.title: live accuracy style
bodyChildren.desc: Change the style of the live accuracy displayed during the test.

bodyChildren.title: live word burst style
bodyChildren.desc: Change the style of the live burst speed displayed during the test.

bodyChildren.title: timer color
bodyChildren.desc: Change the color of the progress, live speed, accuracy and burst text.

bodyChildren.title: timer opacity
bodyChildren.desc: Change the opacity of the progress, live speed, burst and accuracy text.

bodyChildren.title: highlight mode
bodyChildren.desc: Change what is highlighted during the test.

bodyChildren.title: typed effect
bodyChildren.desc: Change how typed words are shown.

bodyChildren.title: tape mode
bodyChildren.desc: Only shows one line which scrolls horizontally. Setting this to 'word' will make it scroll after every word and 'letter' will scroll after every keypress. Works best with smooth line scroll enabled and a monospace font.

bodyChildren.title: tape margin
bodyChildren.desc: When in tape mode, set the carets position from the left edge of the typing test as a percentage (for example, 50% centers it).

bodyChildren.title: smooth line scroll
bodyChildren.desc: When enabled, the line transition will be animated.

bodyChildren.title: show all lines
bodyChildren.desc: When enabled, the website will show all lines for word, custom and quote mode tests - otherwise the lines will be limited to 3, and will automatically scroll. Using this could cause the timer text and live speed to not be visible.

bodyChildren.title: always show decimal places
bodyChildren.desc: Always shows decimal places for values on the result page, without the need to hover over the stats.

bodyChildren.title: typing speed unit
bodyChildren.desc: Display typing speed in the specified unit.

bodyChildren.title: start graphs at zero
bodyChildren.desc: Force graph axis to always start at zero, no matter what the data is. Turning this off may exaggerate the value changes.

bodyChildren.title: max line width
bodyChildren.desc: Change the maximum width of the typing test, measured in characters. Setting this to 0 will align the words to the edges of the content area.

bodyChildren.title: font size
bodyChildren.desc: Change the font size of the test words.

bodyChildren.title: font family
bodyChildren.desc: Change the font family used by the website. Using a local font will override your choice. Note: Local fonts are not sent to the server and will not persist across devices.use local fontor

bodyChildren.title: keymap mode
bodyChildren.desc: Displays your current layout while taking a test. React shows what you pressed and Next shows what you need to press next.

bodyChildren.title: flip test colors
bodyChildren.desc: By default, typed text is brighter than the future text. When enabled, the colors will be flipped and the future text will be brighter than the already typed text.

bodyChildren.title: colorful mode
bodyChildren.desc: When enabled, the test words will use the main color, instead of the text color, making the website more colorful.

bodyChildren.title: custom background
bodyChildren.desc: Set an image url or local image to be a custom background image. Local image always take priority over the image url. Cover fits the image to cover the screen. Contain fits the image to be fully visible. Max fits the image corner to corner.Note: The local image is stored in your browser's local storage and will not be uploaded to the server. This means that if you clear your browser's local storage or use a different browser, the local image will be lost.use local imageor

bodyChildren.title: auto switch theme
bodyChildren.desc: Enabling this will automatically switch the theme between light and dark depending on the system theme.

bodyChildren.title: random theme
bodyChildren.desc: After completing a test, the theme will be set to a random one. The random themes are not saved to your config. If set to 'favorite' only favorite themes will be randomized. If set to 'light' or 'dark', only presets with light or dark background colors will be randomized, respectively. If set to 'auto' dark or light themes are used, depending on your system theme. If set to 'custom', custom themes will be randomized.

bodyChildren.title: theme
bodyChildren.desc: Completely change the look and feel of the website by picking one of the presets, or by creating your own completely custom theme.

bodyChildren.title: show key tips
bodyChildren.desc: Shows the keybind tips at the bottom of the page.

bodyChildren.title: show out of focus warning
bodyChildren.desc: Shows an out of focus reminder after 1 second of being 'out of focus' (not being able to type).

bodyChildren.title: caps lock warning
bodyChildren.desc: Displays a warning when caps lock is on.

bodyChildren.title: show average
bodyChildren.desc: Displays your average speed and/or accuracy over the last 10 tests.

bodyChildren.title: ads
bodyChildren.desc: You can disable or enable ads at any time. "Result" will show one ad on the result page, "on" will add floating vertical banners, and "sellout" will add multiple ads on every page.

bodyChildren.title: import/export settings
bodyChildren.desc: Import or export the settings as JSON.

bodyChildren.title: update cookie preferences
bodyChildren.desc: If you changed your mind about which cookies you consent to, you can change your preferences here.

bodyChildren.title: the rest
bodyChildren.desc: Niche settings that only affect minor functionality. Most people will never need to touch these.

bodyChildren.title: reset settings
bodyChildren.desc: Resets settings to the default (but doesn't touch your tags and presets).You can't undo this!
